decisions.panic: Stop only CBS-registered agent process trees; keep WebUI and Broker running; do not disconnect the whole machine
decisions.astrbot_breaker: Disable the CBS bridge by default; stop AstrBot only when the user explicitly opts into CBS-managed lifecycle
decisions.zero_trace_uninstall: Delete SCM service, WFP rules, and the service account by default; preserve user data unless the user explicitly selects full deletion
decisions.custom_tier: High-based allow-listed combinations; disallow contradictory configurations
decisions.credential_proxy: Explicit opt-in for any AstrBot base_url write; backup and rollback required

third_party.astrbot: external upstream application; CBS validates only the integration boundary
